d: Bihar Special Bus Service : chhath puja par ghar jane ki taiyari kar rahe hain....lekin tren men kanpharm tikat nahin mil raha....to pareshan hone ki jarurat nahin hai....kyonki ab bihar jane vale yatriyon ke lie ek aisa Option samne aaya hai, jismen na sirph ghar pahunchne ka rasta aasan ho sakta hai, balki tikat ke kirae men 1000 rupye se jyada ki bachat bhi ho sakti hai....ji han bihar men chhath puja ke lie karib 200 speshal bason ki vyavastha ki gaee hai.... lekin sabse bara saval ye hai ki ye basen kahan se chalengi dilli se bihar jane ka kiraya kitna hoga aur kin ruton par sabse…
